summary: The trace shows the agent modified JSON key names from the standard schema (baseline_value→baseline_upr, etc.) and dismissed a verification failure as a 'false positive', leading to task failure. Updates: (1) Fix verify_deliverables.py p-value threshold to not flag legitimate small p-values like 1e-11, (2) Strengthen SKILL.md warnings against modifying schema keys, (3) Add these specific key mismatches to schema.md reference.
